integrity: The analytic theorem was checked against the direct finite-state Feynman-Kac matrix method; finite computational tests do not establish continuum quantifiers. The cited full-text paper already obtains arbitrary-order moments; this record claims only the new strict sign-regime and zero-count classification, not the general moment formula.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-state finite-velocity Markov transport with strictly positive rates, two constant distinct velocities, and optional independent Brownian diffusion. No nonstationary, state-dependent thermal noise, or more-than-two-state claims. Priority remains conditional on finite literature comparison.
title: Sharp one-crossing law for the fourth cumulant of stationary asymmetric telegraph transport
